claims.title: Protect a coherent checker from collective flag noise while pricing in-code errors and leakage

quoted_fields.interface: Fresh isolated logical flag plus state; the same controlled receiver involution before/after the entire completed call (source T=X_p X_q Z_a, identity on retained M); encoded plus/minus readout and off-code outcomes treated as erasures. Collective noise means (Z_f+Z_g) tensor B_M(t), with B_M acting on the non-flag bath. Include all retained memory/reference and actual finite control windows. Code-preserving reference generators realizing this specified full-call instrument, unitary propagators and valid Duhamel identities; bounded integrable D,V couplings for the norm estimates. For forbidden-effect conversion additionally require the specified pointer input/output code, trusted Bell/teleportation and record-retirement task, zero ideal forbidden branches and ONE joint full-Stinespring norm budget. SU2 subsystem protection requires its own encoded preparation/readout and singlet-controlled target operation.
quoted_fields.failure: Flag-code occupancy does not certify coherent plus state, Bell-resource quality, role secrecy or trusted terminal operations. Collective-Z immunity is not arbitrary differential/transverse or target/bath protection. Differential phase theta can give sin²(theta) forbidden effect, reaching1 with no flag-code leakage. The accepted bound is not quartic full-channel/diamond error, normalized conditional correctness, availability or throughput. Per-Kraus bounds cannot be substituted for a joint Stinespring budget. Finite calibration visibility does not acquire a uniform future bath operator bound. The SU2 no-go is only the instantaneous span of27 one-flag-spin/target Pauli cross couplings; more complex encoded controls and bounded-noise stroboscopic protocols remain outside it. DFS/noiseless-subsystem and Pauli-check methods are established antecedents. No physical operation, source numerical certificate, historical originality or matched practical advantage is acquired. Mission NOT_ACHIEVED.
